name: The Shoppes at Latham Circle
summary: The Shoppes at Latham Circle is a well-established community shopping center on Loudon Road in Latham, NY, professionally managed by Nigro Properties. With a 4.2-star rating and convenient location in the Capital Region, it serves as a reliable destination for everyday shopping and dining needs.
demographics: The Shoppes at Latham Circle serves a diverse suburban demographic in the Capital Region of New York, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from Latham and surrounding Albany suburbs. The trade area includes a mix of established homeowners, young families, and working professionals with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000 annually. Shoppers typically seek convenient access to everyday retail needs combined with dining and service options, with strong weekday lunch traffic from nearby office parks and weekend family shopping patterns.
description: The Shoppes at Latham Circle is a prominent community shopping destination located at 800 Loudon Road in Latham, New York, serving the greater Capital Region with convenient access to essential retail, dining, and services. Managed by Nigro Properties, a respected regional developer with over 3.5 million square feet of retail space across 18 properties, this center benefits from professional 24/7 management and decades of property expertise. The shopping center occupies a strategic location along the busy Loudon Road corridor, making it easily accessible to residents throughout the Albany metropolitan area. With a strong 4.2-star rating from nearly 1,400 Google reviews, The Shoppes at Latham Circle has established itself as a reliable community gathering place where local, national, and international tenants serve the daily needs of Capital Region shoppers. The center operates with extended hours from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, providing flexibility for busy families and professionals seeking quality retail experiences in a well-maintained, professionally managed environment.
